changedMainMethods.name: class_119.OnRefreshScreen
changedMainMethods.change: The map BitmapData draw delegates to MapZoneMask.Draw; removing the delegation and relocating branch/exception instruction indices reproduces the preceding body exactly.

review.mapMask: New four-body helper preserves drawing when no mask exists. With a mask, it temporarily draws that mask to a separate bitmap, merges source pixels with its alpha, restores the original mask visibility, parent/index and bitmap mask, disposes its temporary bitmap and rethrows any caught Error. The complete helper is retained byte-for-byte.
review.repaint: ScreenRepaint uses a Sprite instead of Shape and disables mouseEnabled and mouseChildren on its cover. The resolved tick and frame-handler instructions, frame count and Error catches are unchanged; original cover geometry and all other helper behavior remain intact.
review.adapter: One exact method-envelope variant applies the existing 1152-pixel authored map width expression at code offset 788, using six equal-width bytes. All original branches and exception bytes remain unchanged. Existing source and enhanced hashes remain supported; the prior 0.32.2 output is byte-identical.
review.preservation: All 3,775 unrelated main method envelopes and every non-main input tag, including MapZoneMask, ScreenRepaint, AirCompat, RankingsButton and TouchBridge, are retained byte-for-byte. All previous original pool entries, root bindings and the main semantic interface match. No simulation, networking, authentication or gameplay changes.
